description: Source code for the NullDecrypter class implementing a no-op decryption mechanism in the QUIC protocol, including methods for setting keys, decrypting packets, and computing hashes.

classes.name: NullDecrypter
classes.description: A class that implements a null decrypter for QUIC, which performs no actual decryption but verifies packet integrity.

methods.name: SetKey
methods.description: Checks if the provided key is empty; always returns true if empty.

methods.name: SetNoncePrefix
methods.description: Checks if the nonce prefix is empty; always returns true if empty.

methods.name: SetIV
methods.description: Checks if the IV is empty; always returns true if empty.

methods.name: SetHeaderProtectionKey
methods.description: Checks if the header protection key is empty; always returns true if empty.

methods.name: SetPreliminaryKey
methods.description: Should not be called; logs a bug and returns false.

methods.name: SetDiversificationNonce
methods.description: Should not be called; logs a bug and returns true.

methods.name: DecryptPacket
methods.description: Reads hash from ciphertext, verifies it, copies plaintext to output if valid, and checks buffer size.

methods.name: GenerateHeaderProtectionMask
methods.description: Returns a string of five zero bytes.

methods.name: ReadHash
methods.description: Reads a 128-bit hash from the data reader.

methods.name: ComputeHash
methods.description: Computes a 128-bit hash based on the perspective and input data.
